summary: New rule agent.progress (narrative, unprotected, gather 300 / act 800 / echo 400 = 1500 ms) appended to PACE_RULES with match: () => false, so nothing schedules it until E5; a Progress beam choreography: an at-rest-blue ring on the captain, then the stations' mine or phaser at half weight from where the captain is to each piece of work (dock on a merge), and a small hero-blue hit flare as the look lands; MineArgs gains scale; the gallery builds its cell from a pod-sprint merge recast through the rule's own cast; 15 §7, §8 (audit and commands) and 13 §6.1–6.2 updated; gallery-assets counts 17 rules.
notes: match: () => false rather than a new 'directed' flag: the planner, ledger and every matched() test stay exactly as they are; E5 calls rule.cast itself.
A 300 ms gather (light gathers, no travel) so the beam holds a turn and its captain is named; the interpreter names a crew only for a maneuver with a gather.

Beam: the stations' mine (asteroid) and phaser (enemy) at scale 0.5 keep the 13 §6.1 grammar (weapons only at enemies); mine needs a new optional scale, default 1, so Power link and the beamed closes are unchanged.
On a merge the tender's dock act plays during the act, so the merged tender doesn't vanish unexplained; the station doesn't charge, transform or fire.
One-of-every-rule sum rises to 46 315 ms against a 47 250 ms ceiling in maneuvers.test.ts; it still passes, with little room left for E4/E7 additions.
Track record mixed: E1 (medium) failed first review on a docs table; E2 and D1–D3 passed.
